第69章 鬼道人-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

夜幕降临，吴姜一个人留在了郭家的客厅，其他人都被他打发回房间了。

吴姜又给每人塞了两张刚画好的护身符，反复叮嘱他们，晚上不管听到什么动静，都别开门。

李月芽被安排在了二楼的客房，念念飘在她身边，晃来晃去地陪着她。

虽说小丫头没什么大用，但比起李月芽，还是要强点的。

当然，这话吴姜也就敢在心里想想，万万不敢当着念念的面说的，这小丫头心眼小，要是听到这话，指不定要闹多久脾气。

吴姜往客厅的红木沙发上一躺，随手点开手机刷着，直到迷迷糊糊的睡着了，还是什么都没发生。

一夜风平浪静，天刚蒙蒙亮，吴姜揉着发酸的腰坐起身来，心里忍不住吐槽：这破沙发也太膈人了，郭家都是什么品味啊！

心里打定主意，今晚说什么也不在这破沙发上遭罪了。

上午九点多，门外传来汽车引擎的声音，郭云涛的大哥郭云飞，还是放心不下家里，特意从市里赶了回来。

一进门，刚和吴姜和李月芽寒暄了几句，得知家里出事，大概率是闽省那帮家伙搞的鬼，郭云飞的脸色瞬间沉了下来，眼底闪过一丝狠厉，那模样，和他老子，简直是如出一辙。

郭云飞，也是郭大民最看重的接班人，指望郭云涛，说不定厂子哪天就黄了。

“爸，我现在就去查一下那帮人的底细，绝对不会让他们轻易的离开鹿城。吴姜小弟，大哥就不陪你们了，今天让云涛带你们好好转转。”

说完之后，郭云飞又风风火火的出门了，真当他们老郭家现在老实安分的做生意，已经改吃素了？

白天阳光充足，阳气旺盛，脏东西一般不敢轻易露面，自然不会出什么事。

郭云涛闲不住，又想着好好招待吴姜和李月芽，便拉着两人去市里去玩了。

一座风景秀丽的园林里，湖面波光粼粼，李月芽兴致勃勃地蹲在湖边，手里捏着鱼食，一点点往水里撒，看着一群锦鲤争食。

As night fell, Wu Jiang stayed alone in the Guo family's living room, and he sent everyone else back to their rooms.

Wu Jiang stuffed two more freshly drawn amulets into each person and repeatedly told them not to open the door no matter what noise they heard at night.

Li Yueya was arranged in the guest room on the second floor, with Nian Nian floating next to her, wandering around to accompany her.

Although the little girl is not very useful, she is still stronger than Li Yueya.

Of course, Wu Jiang dared to think about this in his heart, and never dared to say it in front of Nian Nian. This little girl was petty, and if she heard this, she might be angry for a long time.

Wu Jiang lay down on the mahogany sofa in the living room, casually opened his phone and scrolled through it until he fell asleep, but nothing happened.

It was a calm night and the sky was just getting bright. Wu Jiang sat up and rubbed his sore waist. He couldn't help complaining in his heart: This broken sofa is too uncomfortable. What kind of taste does the Guo family have?

I made up my mind that I would not suffer anything on this shabby sofa tonight.

At around nine o'clock in the morning, the sound of a car engine came from outside the door. Guo Yuntao's eldest brother Guo Yunfei was still worried about his family and rushed back from the city.

As soon as he entered the door, he had just exchanged a few words with Wu Jiang and Li Yueya. When he learned that the trouble at home was most likely caused by those guys from Fujian Province, Guo Yunfei's face instantly darkened, and there was a fierce look in his eyes. His appearance was exactly the same as his father's.

Guo Yunfei is also Guo Damin's most valued successor. Counting on Guo Yuntao, the factory may become obsolete one day.

"Dad, I'm going to check out the details of that group of people now. I will never let them leave Lucheng easily. Brother Wu Jiang, my eldest brother will not accompany you anymore. Let Yuntao take you around today."

After saying that, Guo Yunfei went out in a hurry. Do you really think that the old Guo family, who is now doing business honestly and peacefully, has changed to a vegetarian diet?

During the day, there is plenty of sunshine and strong yang energy. Dirty things generally do not dare to show up easily, so naturally nothing will happen to them.

Guo Yuntao couldn't sit still and wanted to entertain Wu Jiang and Li Yueya, so he took them to the city to play.

In a beautiful garden, the lake surface was sparkling. Li Yueya squatted enthusiastically by the lake, holding fish food in his hand, and sprinkled it into the water little by little, watching a group of koi carps competing for food.
